turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is Simon from the fraud prevention team at Northgate Bank. Am I speaking with Mrs Okafor?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We've spotted some unusual activity on your debit card, and we've put a temporary block on it to protect you. Before I go on, we will never ask for your PIN, your passwords or a one-time code, and we'll never ask you to move money.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's good to know. What happened?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: There were two card payments last night to an online electronics shop, four hundred and twelve pounds in total. Do you recognise those?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, definitely not. I was asleep. That's really worrying.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I understand, it is alarming. The good news is they were stopped, and you won't lose any money. We'll cancel that card and send a new one, which should reach you in three to five working days.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on. How do I know this is really the bank?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That's a very sensible question. Please hang up and call the number on the back of your card whenever you're ready, and quote the reference ending seven two four. Any of my colleagues can confirm all of this.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, thank you. Is there anything I need to do right now?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nothing urgent. When you've got a moment, check your statement in the app, and tell us if anything else looks wrong. Take your time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Great. Thanks for your help, Simon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You're welcome, Mrs Okafor. Take care. Goodbye.
